Whereas, M/s Go Digit General Insurance Limited (M/s GDGIL) was granted Registration by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of Authority) to conduct general insurance business in India vide IRDAI Registration No. 

Whereas M/s GDGIL has applied to the Authority through General Insurance Council seeking exemption from complying with limits of expenses of stipulated under Section 40B of the Insurance Act, 1938 read with IRDAI (Expenses Management of Insurers transacting General or Health Insurance business) 

> Whereas the Executive Committee of 

> Now therefore, the Authority, after careful consideration of the application of 

> GDGIL and the recommendations of the General Insurance Council, in exercise powers vested in it under Regulation 11 of the IRDAI (Expenses of Management Insurers transacting General or Health Insurance Business) Regulations, 2016, hereby 

> grants exemption to M/s GDGIL from complying with the limits of expenses
